dataset.name: Food Packaging OCR Dataset
dataset.license_terms_and_attribution: UNKNOWN; no licence or terms file was present in the supplied archive or extracted dataset.
dataset.permitted_use: UNKNOWN; confirm original source terms before external demo display, publication, or redistribution.
dataset.selection_scope: Ten manually selected images from official test splits; no image files copied.

ground_truth_scope: Generic OCR only. Detection annotations provide text transcriptions and polygon points; recognition annotations provide a single transcription for each text crop. These are not ingredient, nutrition, allergen, expiry-date, product-field, or regulatory ground truth.
limitations: Publisher/authors, source URL, release/version, licence, attribution requirements, and redistribution permission are UNKNOWN.
Detection and recognition are different tasks and must be evaluated separately.
Detection annotations are referenced by original label-file row; region counts are included, but polygon/transcription quality has not been independently adjudicated.
The recognition transcriptions are provided for cropped text images, not complete package labels.
This manually selected small subset is suitable for smoke testing, not broad performance claims.
The dataset does not establish semantic field extraction or FSSAI/regulatory compliance; no accuracy metric is included.
